scope: Integrated local architectural refactor; no production operations or MET feature work. Documentation-only follow-up records these results without changing the validated source.

environment.execution: Local disposable containers. Integration and benchmarks ran serially; HTTP/DB commands outside socket-restricted sandbox.
environment.migrations: 17 existing migrations applied; schema and migrations identical to baseline; no new migration.

historicalEvidence.summary: The ARQ-01 baseline and ARQ-02..13 validation artifacts document the progressive boundary, contract, composition, projection, study and processing refactors. Historical integration results are preserved as historical evidence and are not reclassified as current ARQ-14 results.

supersedes: The incomplete af3efe7 validation report in commit 88516ad. Earlier integration evidence remains historical.

integration.command: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL URL> TEST_RABBITMQ_URL=<disposable RabbitMQ URL> npm run test:integration
coverage: 10 PostgreSQL AFTER-trigger publication faults and exactly-once recovery
dataset export determinism and temporal splits

projections.baselinePreparation: git archive 217331a extracted to /tmp/highbr-arq14-baseline-final; build with same installed dependencies; run the same comparator with cwd set to the baseline and ARQ_CORPUS_OUTPUT=/tmp/arq14-final-baseline-projections. Only top-level calculationMs is omitted from comparison.

commands: DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL URL> node dist/processing-cli.js status
DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL URL> node dist/processing-cli.js coverage

benchmark.command: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL URL> node scripts/benchmark-release.cjs --reset-disposable --baseline docs/architecture/evidence/benchmark.json --output /tmp/arq14-final-benchmark.json
benchmark.baselineReplayCommand: From the extracted 217331a baseline: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<same disposable PostgreSQL URL> node scripts/benchmark-release.cjs --reset-disposable --output /tmp/arq14-baseline-replay-benchmark.json
benchmark.comparison: Historical baseline and freshly replayed baseline both pass the original thresholds. No threshold or benchmark assertion was weakened.
benchmark.interpretation: Against same-environment replay: route p95 ratios 0.933–1.070, ingestion 0.994, rebuild 1.004. Historical rebuild +11.15% is also present in replay (+10.67%); no refactor regression trigger. Shared workstation and one fixture do not establish production capacity.

persistedData.jobStates: equal; all completed and leases released
persistedData.snapshotCommand: After each serial benchmark: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL URL> node docs/architecture/evidence/arq14/snapshot-database.cjs <repository-root> <snapshot-output.json>
persistedData.normalization: Sorted JSON keys and rows; bigint decimal; ISO dates. Omit processing wall-clock processedAt, playerStats.lastUpdated and surrogate IDs only on matchTeam/championStats/playerStats/playerChampionStats. Preserve match identities, event timestamps, values, nulls, versions and lastPlayedAt.

resolvedFindings: Published STEAL_CHALLENGES and MatchReportController through the offline composition entrypoint; reconciliation and benchmark execute successfully.

Rollback test expectations distinguish patch-only champion aggregates from patch plus ALL player aggregates; every row still requires gamesPlayed=1 and redelivery leaves the complete snapshot unchanged.
Snapshot rollback spec now exercises the full processing use case and asserts RETRY_WAIT, no completedAt, no lease and the recorded failure instead of the old direct-persistence PROCESSING state.
ARQ-13 completion evidence added to board; MET-21 native ARQ-14 dependency restored.

initialFailedRuns.first: 11 expectation failures: 10 new aggregate row-count assertions and one stale direct-persistence status assertion; 53 other integration tests passed.
initialFailedRuns.second: 10 row-count assertions still conflated champion and player scopes; 54 other integration tests passed.
initialFailedRuns.resolution: Expected scopes verified against both original and refactored writers, then all 64 integration tests passed. No production formula or failure policy changed.

boardAuditBeforeRelease.partialWorktrees: evidence/arq14/met-worktrees.json; existing MET-21 partial work preserved.
boardAuditBeforeRelease.releasePolicy: Move ARQ-14 #52 to Done after accepted evidence is committed; preserve every MET dependency and existing completion state.

metResumption: Start from the final local dev and preserve worktree changes before rebasing or transplanting paused work.
Replace removed core paths and internal module imports with the public matches/dataset/stats/collector/processing contracts documented in docs/architecture/migration-map.md.
Keep original MET dependency order; a released architecture gate does not complete unfinished MET cards.
Run architecture:check --strict plus affected suites for each resumed card; do not recreate compatibility aliases.
limitations: One real fixture and nine synthetic variants; no claim of multi-patch empirical coverage.
Local benchmark on a shared workstation, no production SLA or load-capacity claim.
Integration is into local dev; no GitHub push or production deployment is part of this validation.
